heading: Play. Compete. Grow.
subheading: Physical endurance, teamwork, and mental stamina through regular sports engagement.
notice: Sports disciplines listed represent planned campus physical activities. Intramural sports calendars and tournament schedules are published term-wise.

items.name: Cricket
items.description: Pitch practice, fielding drills, and intramural league matches fostering team coordination and tactical composure.

items.name: Volleyball
items.description: High-energy court sport developing quick reflexes, vertical stamina, and cooperative team communication.

items.name: Basketball
items.description: Fast-paced game emphasizing endurance, strategic spatial awareness, rapid decision-making, and agility.

items.name: Badminton
items.description: Singles and doubles practice focusing on quick lateral movement, wrist dexterity, and aerobic stamina.

items.name: Athletics & Track
items.description: Sprints, relay races, distance running, and general fitness drills building core physical stamina.

items.name: Chess & Table Tennis
items.description: Strategic mind sports and indoor games that sharpen analytical thinking, patience, and concentration during downtime.
